description: The order-type baseline is the mean of short interest over the raw matched snapshot records of that order type.

b.request: For each sentiment snapshot matched to a transaction record, group the matched rows by transaction reference and order type mix; report the transaction reference, order type mix, average short-interest ratio and option-volume ratio across non-null snapshot values, and the ratio of that transaction’s average short interest to the mean short interest across all raw matched snapshot records with the same order type mix; order by this ratio descending with null ratios last and return 10 rows.
b.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT
    t.transreg AS transaction_reference,
    t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
    s.shortintrt,
    s.optvolrt
  FROM transactionrecord AS t
  JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    ON s.transref = t.transreg
), grouped AS (
  SELECT
    transaction_reference,
    order_type_mix,
    AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest_ratio,
    AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY transaction_reference, order_type_mix
)
SELECT
  g.transaction_reference,
  g.order_type_mix,
  g.avg_short_interest_ratio,
  g.avg_option_volume_ratio,
  g.avg_short_interest_ratio / NULLIF(mix.mean_short_interest_ratio, 0) AS short_interest_ratio_to_mix_mean
FROM grouped AS g
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT order_type_mix, AVG(shortintrt) AS mean_short_interest_ratio
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY order_type_mix
) AS mix
  ON mix.order_type_mix IS NOT DISTINCT FROM g.order_type_mix
ORDER BY short_interest_ratio_to_mix_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
b.raw: For each sentiment snapshot matched to a transaction record, group the matched rows by transaction reference and order type mix; report the transaction reference, order type mix, average short-interest ratio and option-volume ratio across non-null snapshot values, and the ratio of that transaction’s average short interest to the mean short interest across all raw matched snapshot records with the same order type mix; order by this ratio descending with null ratios last and return 10 rows.

d.request: For each transaction record with at least one sentiment snapshot matching its `transreg`, report its transaction reference, order type mix, mean non-null `shortintrt`, mean non-null `optvolrt`, and the ratio of that transaction’s mean `shortintrt` to the mean `shortintrt` across all raw matched snapshot records sharing its order type mix; order-type means use matched snapshots without transaction-level aggregation. Return the 10 highest ratios first, with null ratios last, and do not round values.
d.sql:
WITH transaction_means AS (
  SELECT
    t.transreg,
    t.ordertypedist,
    AVG(s.shortintrt) AS mean_shortintrt,
    AVG(s.optvolrt) AS mean_optvolrt
  FROM transactionrecord AS t
  JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    ON s.transref = t.transreg
  GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist
),
order_type_means AS (
  SELECT
    t.ordertypedist,
    AVG(s.shortintrt) AS mean_shortintrt
  FROM transactionrecord AS t
  JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    ON s.transref = t.transreg
  GROUP BY t.ordertypedist
)
SELECT
  tm.transreg,
  tm.ordertypedist,
  tm.mean_shortintrt,
  tm.mean_optvolrt,
  tm.mean_shortintrt / NULLIF(otm.mean_shortintrt, 0) AS shortintrt_ratio
FROM transaction_means AS tm
JOIN order_type_means AS otm
  ON tm.ordertypedist IS NOT DISTINCT FROM otm.ordertypedist
ORDER BY shortintrt_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

c.request: For each transaction that has sentiment data (matching `transref` to `transactionrecord.transreg`, dropping anything unmatched), along with its order type mix, show the transaction reference, the order type mix, its average short interest days to cover and average option volume ratio (ignoring missing values), and how its average short interest compares with the average short interest for its order type mix, as a ratio. Do not round. List the 10 highest ratios first, with missing ratios last. The order-type baseline is the mean of short interest over the raw matched snapshot records of that order type.
c.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT
    t.transreg,
    t.ordertypedist,
    s.shortintrt,
    s.optvolrt
  FROM transactionrecord AS t
  INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    ON s.transref = t.transreg
), transaction_averages AS (
  SELECT
    transreg,
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest_days_to_cover,
    AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist
), order_type_baselines AS (
  SELECT
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(shortintrt) AS baseline_avg_short_interest
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT
  a.transreg AS transaction_reference,
  a.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
  a.avg_short_interest_days_to_cover,
  a.avg_option_volume_ratio,
  a.avg_short_interest_days_to_cover / NULLIF(b.baseline_avg_short_interest, 0) AS short_interest_ratio_to_order_type_average
FROM transaction_averages AS a
JOIN order_type_baselines AS b
  ON b.ordertypedist IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.ordertypedist
ORDER BY short_interest_ratio_to_order_type_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

a.request: For each transaction with sentiment snapshots (match `sentimentandfundamentals.transref` to `transactionrecord.transreg`, dropping unmatched records), together with its order type mix (`ordertypedist`), compute the average short interest days to cover (`shortintrt`) and the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`) across its snapshots, ignoring missing values. Compare each transaction's average short interest with a baseline for its order type mix, computed as the average `shortintrt` over all matched sentiment snapshots within that mix (each snapshot counted once). List the transaction reference, order type mix, average short interest, average option volume ratio, and the ratio of the transaction's average short interest to that baseline. Do not round. Sort by the ratio from highest to lowest with missing ratios last, and show the top 10.
a.sql:
WITH transaction_averages AS (
  SELECT
    tr.transreg,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio
  FROM transactionrecord AS tr
  JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
    ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist
),
order_type_baselines AS (
  SELECT
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) AS baseline_short_interest
  FROM transactionrecord AS tr
  JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
    ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist
)
SELECT
  ta.transreg AS transaction_reference,
  ta.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
  ta.avg_short_interest,
  ta.avg_option_volume_ratio,
  ta.avg_short_interest / NULLIF(otb.baseline_short_interest, 0) AS short_interest_ratio
FROM transaction_averages AS ta
JOIN order_type_baselines AS otb
  ON ta.ordertypedist = otb.ordertypedist
ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
